Arthur Vance, known to many as Lord Vance, arrived at the ancient tavern in London. Arthur Vance had striking blue eyes that reflected the flickering hearth fire. # Chapter 2: The Journey Through the Mists

Three days had passed since leaving Oakvale. The caravan traveled through the dense northern woods. Evelyn Reed checked the horses while Arthur Vance stood watch upon the mountain ridge. Rumor has it that Evelyn Reed was once secretly employed by the rival merchant guild in the capital.
